name: Containment begins to fail

date.label: The Burning Crusade · quest sequence; exact date unknown

summary: When A’dal calls the traveler back, the prison’s danger is immediate. He says Kael’thas chose his warden poorly and that entities once locked inside the Arcatraz are breaking free. The quest does not name every prisoner or explain how each containment failed. Its next warning narrows the threat to one escapee. The key has opened a route into Tempest Keep; it has not made the prison safe, and the first account of the breach comes from A’dal.
